title: Orlando Cop Gets Fired After Choking a Man While Arresting Him
description:
** (Disclaimer: This video content is intended for educational and informational purposes only) **
The officer, Frank Sikos, a 20-year veteran of the Orlando Police Department, has been relieved of duty and is facing charges after newly released body camera footage shows him pushing a man to the ground, then choked him against the ground, prior to his arrest near Lake Ivanhoe last September. The video footage, taken from Sikos’ body camera during the Sept. 8 incident, shows officers approaching Bennett Graham Robinson about 4 a.m. in the 1400 block of Alden Road, after neighbors had called 911 because they said they saw him attempting to enter a construction site.
